proven_policy_truth: New account begins ONBOARDING/EXPOSURE_PENDING with no evaluation end timestamp.
The policy activates only after profile_ready + market_data_available + first_shortlist_generated.
Self-service activation duration is 21 days and signup alone does not consume days.
Paid Pro entitlement takes precedence over Evaluation.
observed_customer_path: POST /api/v1/profile persists a valid profile and executes bootstrap_account for the same authenticated account.
bootstrap_account classifies current actionable opportunities and can emit high-match opportunity events.
The inspected profile/bootstrap/classification customer path does not record Evaluation activation events.
Therefore policy-level tests that manually call record_evaluation_event do not prove that a real customer can ever advance from ONBOARDING to EVALUATION_ACTIVE.
customer_risk: A customer may receive a profile and Radar value while the Evaluation remains ONBOARDING with expires_at=null.
The product can truthfully say the 21-day window has not started, but cannot yet prove that normal value delivery will start it automatically.
Commercial conversion timing/retention metrics are not trustworthy until real customer events drive the lifecycle.
expected_truth: A successfully completed customer profile records profile_ready for that authenticated tenant.
market_data_available is recorded only from evidence that usable market data is actually available; empty/error/unknown source state cannot satisfy it.
first_shortlist_generated is recorded only when a relevant shortlist is actually generated for the same tenant; zero/unknown is not success.
The 21-day clock begins exactly once when all three conditions become true, not at signup and not before value readiness.
Replays/restarts are idempotent enough not to restart or extend the clock accidentally.
